text: [excited] Toyota just built a new pickup for America... and it tops out at twenty-five miles an hour!
It's tiny. Eleven feet long. About half a full-size pickup.
[curious] And the steering wheel? It's on the right.
Why so slow? At twenty-five, it counts as a low-speed vehicle. So in many states, it's stuck on roads of thirty-five or slower.
[amused] But it hauls six hundred pounds, has four-wheel drive... and air conditioning.
[deadpan] To sell it, Toyota revived a brand it killed in twenty sixteen. Scion.
[playfully] Would you drive one? Send this to a friend who drives way too fast.
